result.description: Nebula Arbor 27Q is a fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for office, design, and general productivity use. It features a 3840 x 2160 IPS panel, 60Hz refresh rate, 350 nits typical brightness, and support for HDR10 content playback. Connectivity includes USB-C, DisplayPort, and HDMI, with a built-in ergonomic stand offering tilt, swivel, height adjustment, and pivot rotation. The display emphasizes color consistency and a clean minimal chassis for modern workspaces.
